page.overview:
What is Wind Blade?

A Wind Blade is a weapon used by that was Sonya Blade in Mortal Kombat 4 and Mortal Kombat Gold. It bears a strong resemblance to a [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinwheel_(toy) pinwheel], tipped with sharpened blades, and is not analogous to any known real-world weapon.
